'''Edmund Gray Forget Han return with me to the Clouds''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Edmund Gray]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10592">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10592 Forget Han  return with me to the Clouds], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 22 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10592/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10592/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018114537/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10592/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Edmund Gray]]
* '''Published:''' 22 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Forget Han  return with me to the Clouds''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Profit Gray LS 2000 10592.txt |Download]] (omits Alien Han: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Lando betrays Han one final time and takes his girl, and ditches him, returning to his mining colony, leaving him stuck in the Audience Chamber with an Elom as his sole companion.Big direct damage in the saftey of interior sites.

The post also lists 1x Alien Han, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''Forget Han  return with me to the Clouds'''
* '''Author:''' edmund "edmund" gray
* '''Published:''' September 22, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Lando betrays Han one final time and takes his girl, and ditches him, returning to his mining colony, leaving him stuck in the Audience Chamber with an Elom as his sole companion.Big direct damage in the saftey of interior sites.

=== Strategy ===

Please know what Bo Shuda and Uh-Oh does before you review.

Leave Han at the AC with an Elom and Bo Shuda, get Order out and watch your opponent scramble out of the AC.

While your doing this get the CC sites out and fortify, just sit back force drain and direct damage, with BT and Landing Claws you should be able to slow most space decks. Projections for their sites.

This deck has enormous fighting potential especially with the lift tubes(again know what this card does before you review), and should be able to repel most imperials, don't forget your safe from walkers and that Lando adds a battle destiny with another alien(Eloms) and that this deck is really high destiny.

The Insurrection is protection against Elis Helrots and pulls the dbs, but if Elis is dead in your area then take it out with the DBs as well.

Acitivation shouldn't be a big problem you start with 5+whatever opponent gives, you can pull 2 docking bays, and 3 of the CC sites give 2.

Sorry about the mess takes care of U-3p0.

This deck also has the advantage of baffaling your opponent, as it is quite orginal.

I don't think much more explaining needs to be done, see yah
